name: FoPost
tagline: Draft, schedule and publish social posts, answer your inbox and read analytics. You approve first.
description: FoPost is social media management for teams and AI agents. Write a post once and publish it to X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Bluesky, Pinterest, Reddit and more. Schedule posts or drop them into a posting queue, answer comments and DMs from one inbox, and read analytics across every account. AI agents such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor connect to the hosted MCP server to draft, schedule and report; developers use the REST API, SDKs and CLI. Nothing publishes until you approve it. Pricing is usage-based, with a free credit every month.
